facts.statement: During the Spooktacular season, vampires and werewolves compete in a dance contest judged by the Pumpkin Prince; the side with the most fans wins and gets a piece of his special cake.
facts.quote: el equipo que realicé el baile más aterrador será coronado como el monstruo más temible

facts.statement: The contest is held in the Spooktacular season, with both sides on the outskirts of the marsh location before the Pumpkin King.
facts.quote: A lo largo de la temporada Spooktacular ambos lados tendrán que mostrar sus habilidades al Rey Calabaza

article_summaries.title: Vampiros vs. Hombres Lobos (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post for the Spooktacular season describes a Vampires vs. Werewolves dance contest run for the Pumpkin Prince. Players start with Madame Zelda, pick a side, and wear costumes of their side when the in-game announcement appears; the side with the most fans wins a piece of the Pumpkin Prince's special cake. The post gives no exact date; it says 'posted 7 months, 2 weeks ago' relative to the capture date of 2011-06-04.
